title: Prompt cache entries must be scoped by registry URI and active workspace
answers: load_prompt returns a prompt from the wrong registry after switching registry URI in one process
prompt cache shared across multiple registries or workspaces returns another team's prompt version
cached prompt from workspace A appears in workspace B until TTL expires
body:
Symptom: after an application uses two registries (or two workspaces) in one process, load_prompt returns a prompt version from the other registry or workspace without contacting it, until the cache TTL expires.
Root cause: mlflow/prompt/registry_utils.py:PromptCacheKey.from_parts keyed entries only by name, version and alias, and PromptCache.delete_all filtered only by name, so the process-wide PromptCache.get_instance() was shared across registries and workspaces.
Fix pattern: give PromptCacheKey a registry_namespace (sha256 hex of the resolved registry URI, via _get_prompt_cache_namespace) and a workspace (get_request_workspace()). Make registry_uri a required keyword on from_parts, from_uri, PromptCache.delete and PromptCache.delete_all, and pass self._registry_uri from each MlflowClient prompt method in mlflow/tracking/client.py:MlflowClient.
Constraints: Do not put the raw registry URI in the key; it can contain credentials (the tests assert the repr does not leak them). Bulk invalidation must build its scope through the same from_parts path so its match equals key creation. TTL and reuse behavior are unchanged.
applies: Any code that reads, writes or invalidates prompt cache entries in mlflow/prompt or the prompt methods of the tracking client.
says: Switching between workspaces causes our application to load prompts belonging to another team.
Loading a registered prompt returns stale versions cached from a different model registry.
Isolate prompt versions so one workspace cannot see prompt templates from another.
Fetching prompts in multi-tenant environments serves cached content from the wrong project space.
search: Prompt cache entries must include a registry namespace and workspace identifier to isolate cached prompts across different registries and workspaces. PromptCacheKey uses a sha256 hex digest of the resolved registry URI via _get_prompt_cache_namespace alongside get_request_workspace() in mlflow/prompt/registry_utils.py. MlflowClient passes self._registry_uri to prompt caching methods, requiring registry_uri on from_parts, from_uri, delete, and delete_all without embedding raw URI credentials in key representations.
